selection_rule: Use update_every=4 for the A/C/D pilot unless update_every=1 improves the equal-weight mean future-fault AP over the three first-exposure first-100 windows by more than 0.05 absolute. If that threshold is exceeded, choose update_every=1 only when its measured full-run p95 update latency remains finite and the run completes without resource-guard violation. No other budget parameter may be changed.
why: update_every=4 is the prior deployment-plausible registered online cadence; the bounded update_every=1 run tests whether the long 1200-interval first exposures are still under-optimized without opening a broad tuning search.
